en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street with large trees and a substantial multi-storey school building on the right. The architecture features tall rectangular windows, a central arched entrance with steps, and a slightly mansard-style roof. Further down the street more institutional-looking buildings line the road. The caption at the top left reads in German, indicating this is a view of a public school in Oederan, Saxony.
